findings.finding: Currency mismatch: project hardcodes BYN (Belarusian rubles) but spec uses ₽ (Russian rubles) for all monetary display and calculation.
findings.reasoning: format.ts exports CURRENCY = 'BYN' and formatMoney/formatMoneyShort append ' BYN'. The microloan calculator, result summary, chart, schedule, and admin type management all need to display amounts in ₽. Reusing existing format functions would incorrectly show 'BYN'. A separate formatter or parameterized currency is needed.
findings.evidence: format.ts:2 declares CURRENCY = 'BYN'; format.ts:14-15 formatMoney appends ' BYN'. Spec examples use '10 000 ₽', '10 240 ₽', '3 000 до 100 000 ₽'. No currency configuration exists in the project.
findings.conditions: Implementation reusing format.ts functions without currency parameterization
findings.impact: All monetary displays would show wrong currency symbol, misleading demo users and breaking acceptance criteria verification

findings.finding: localStorage write failures are silently swallowed in mock.ts save() and admin operations, but spec requires showing error, not confirming save, and rolling back UI to last saved state.
findings.reasoning: mock.ts save() at line 53-60 catches all errors and does nothing. Admin create/update/delete (lines 265-320) call save() after mutation but don't propagate save failures. Spec requires: 'если запись в localStorage не удалась — не показывать успешную отправку' and 'показать ошибку, не подтверждать изменение как сохранённое и вернуть интерфейс к фактически сохранённым данным'. Current implementation cannot satisfy this without mock.ts changes.
findings.evidence: mock.ts:54-59 save() catches and ignores errors. adminCreateOffer/adminUpdateOffer/adminDeleteOffer call save() but don't check result. Spec lines 36, 43 require explicit error handling and UI rollback.
findings.violated_requirement: Underengineering — applicable failure behavior for local write operations
findings.conditions: localStorage quota exceeded, private browsing mode, storage disabled, or corrupted state
findings.impact: Users would see false success confirmation; admin changes would appear saved but be lost on reload; no way to diagnose persistence failures

findings.finding: Microloan calculation types (product type, application, profile) don't exist in types.ts; Api interface has no microloan methods. Spec assumes these will be added but doesn't acknowledge the type surface expansion.
findings.reasoning: types.ts covers mortgage CalcParams, CalcResult, BankOffer, Scenario, Me, etc. Microloan needs: MicroloanType (name, min/max amount, graceDays, dailyRatePct, active), ApplicantProfile (fullName, phone, email), MicroloanApplication (typeId, amount, termDays, calculatedTotal, status, createdAt, profileSnapshot). Api needs: listMicroloanTypes, adminCreateType, adminUpdateType, adminDeactivateType, adminActivateType, createApplication, listUserApplications, adminListApplications, adminUpdateApplicationStatus. This is a significant type surface addition not reflected in spec's feasibility assessment.
findings.evidence: types.ts:162-202 Api interface only has mortgage/auth/scenario/notification/offer methods. Spec describes microloan types, applications, admin management without referencing type definitions.
findings.conditions: Implementing TypeScript-strict frontend with new domain types
findings.impact: Type errors during implementation; inconsistent typing patterns; potential runtime errors if types don't match localStorage data shape

findings.finding: Admin microloan type management (create, edit, deactivate, reactivate) mirrors existing admin offer pattern but spec requires validation-before-save and rollback on localStorage failure. Current adminUpdateOffer mutates state then calls save() which silently fails — no rollback possible.
findings.reasoning: AdminOffersPage validates in OfferForm (client-side) then calls api.adminUpdateOffer which mutates state.offers[index] then calls save(). If save() fails (silently), state is already mutated. Spec requires rollback to 'фактически сохранённым данным'. Need: (1) validate before mutation, (2) save() must return success/failure, (3) on failure, revert state mutation. Current pattern doesn't support this.
findings.evidence: mock.ts:273-313 adminUpdateOffer mutates state.offers[index] then calls save(). save() ignores errors. Spec line 42-43 requires validation gate and rollback on persistence failure.
findings.violated_requirement: Underengineering — data integrity under partial failure
findings.conditions: localStorage write fails after in-memory mutation (quota, corruption, private mode)
findings.impact: UI shows updated type but reload reverts to old state — confusing inconsistency; no error shown to admin

findings.finding: New routes for microloan calculator, user applications, admin microloan types/applications need integration into App.tsx and Layout.tsx navigation. Spec doesn't address routing structure or navigation placement.
findings.reasoning: App.tsx defines routes: / (CalculatorPage), /login, /register, /verify-email, /scenarios, /compare, /notifications, /admin/offers. Layout.tsx nav shows: Калькулятор, Мои сценарии, Сравнение, Админка (admin only). Microloan feature needs: /microloan (calculator), /microloan/application (profile+apply), /microloan/applications (user list), /admin/microloan (types), /admin/microloan/applications (admin apps). Navigation: add 'Микрозайм' link (public), 'Мои заявки' (user), 'Микрозаймы' admin section (admin). This is feasible but spec omits routing/navigation design.
findings.evidence: App.tsx and Layout.tsx define current routing/nav. Spec describes screens but not URLs or nav integration.
findings.conditions: Implementing feature without defined routes breaks user flows
findings.impact: Incomplete implementation; users can't navigate to microloan features; admin can't access management screens

findings.finding: Reusing mortgage PaymentChart and ScheduleTable for microloan single-payment schedule is overengineering — they assume monthly principal/interest breakdown over many periods, but microloan has one payment at term end with simple interest.
findings.reasoning: PaymentChart and ScheduleTable are designed for mortgage amortization schedules (monthly rows, principal/interest/balance columns). Microloan formula: single payment = principal + principal × daily_rate × max(0, days - grace). Schedule has exactly one row. Forcing mortgage components requires dummy data or extensive props to hide irrelevant columns, adding complexity. A simple custom component (e.g., MicroloanSchedule with one row) is simpler and more maintainable.
findings.alternative: Create a minimal MicroloanSchedule component showing: term days, principal, interest, total — single row. Reuse only generic UI primitives (Card, Table from ui.tsx).
findings.evidence: ScheduleTable.tsx expects ScheduleRow[] with month, payment, principal, interest, balance. PaymentChart expects schedule for area chart. Microloan has no monthly breakdown — only one payment at end. Spec: 'Платёж единственный, в конце срока'.
findings.violated_requirement: Overengineering — custom mechanisms duplicating simpler presentation
findings.impact: Unnecessary complexity adapting mortgage components; misleading UI showing monthly breakdown for a single-payment product; harder to maintain

findings.finding: Double-submit protection for application creation is specified but no implementation approach exists in current patterns; mock.ts signIn and api calls have no request deduplication.
findings.reasoning: Spec requires: 'Защитить отправку от повторного создания одной и той же заявки из-за двойного клика или повторного submit'. Current codebase has no reusable pattern for this — forms use simple busy state. Need either: (a) form-level submission guard (disable button + ref flag), (b) idempotency key in application data, or (c) mockApi-level deduplication. None exists; must be designed.
findings.evidence: AuthPages.tsx LoginPage uses busy state but no deduplication. mockApi methods don't track pending requests. Spec line 36 explicitly requires this protection.
findings.violated_requirement: Underengineering — missing duplicate request behavior for user flow
findings.conditions: User double-clicks submit button, or form submits twice due to browser behavior
findings.impact: Duplicate applications created in localStorage with same data; user sees two identical applications; admin sees duplicates

findings.finding: Existing admin guard (RequireAuth with admin prop) and Layout navigation for admin only check isAdmin from auth context (roles.includes('ADMIN')). Mock assigns ADMIN role when email contains 'admin'. This works but spec doesn't clarify that demo admin login requires email with 'admin'.
findings.reasoning: RequireAuth.tsx:16-17 redirects non-admin users from admin routes. AuthContext.tsx:66 derives isAdmin from roles.includes('ADMIN'). mock.ts:86 assigns roles: email.includes('admin') ? ['USER','ADMIN'] : ['USER']. Spec says 'Административные экраны недоступны неавторизованным пользователям и пользователям без роли admin' — this matches. But spec doesn't document that demo admin access requires 'admin' in email, which is a UX detail for internal testing.
findings.evidence: RequireAuth.tsx:7 checks isAdmin. mock.ts:83-87 signIn assigns ADMIN role based on email. Layout.tsx:47 shows admin nav link only when isAdmin. Spec line 40 references existing guard.
findings.conditions: Developer testing admin features without knowing 'admin' email requirement
findings.impact: Minor — discoverable but undocumented demo credential requirement

findings.finding: Spec requires 'VITE_USE_MOCKS=true' for local demo login and 'отдельную систему входа не добавлять'. Current mock login accepts any email + password (8+ chars) and assigns USER role (ADMIN if email contains 'admin'). This works but spec doesn't specify that demo users must use this mock auth flow (no registration needed, any credentials work).
findings.reasoning: AuthPages.tsx LoginPage uses api.login which in mock mode (mock.ts:134-139) accepts any email/password (password.length >= 8). No registration required for mock. Spec line 34: 'Для локального сценария входа требуется конфигурация VITE_USE_MOCKS=true; отдельную систему входа не добавлять'. This matches but spec should clarify: demo users just enter any email/password (8+ chars) — no registration step. This is a UX detail for internal testing.
findings.evidence: mock.ts:134-139 login accepts any email with password >= 8 chars. AuthPages.tsx:204-208 calls login. Spec line 34, 52 reference VITE_USE_MOCKS and no separate auth.
findings.conditions: Developer testing user flow without knowing mock auth accepts any credentials
findings.impact: Minor — discoverable but undocumented demo credential behavior

findings.finding: Spec requires mandatory file selection in application form: 'обязательный выбор файла... показать его имя до ухода со страницы, не передавать файл и не сохранять ни файл, ни его имя'. Current ui.tsx has TextInput but no FileInput component. This is a new UI primitive needed.
findings.reasoning: ui.tsx exports: Card, Field, TextInput, Button, Alert, Badge, Spinner, PageTitle, Segmented, Stamp, cx. No file input component exists. Spec requires file selection UI (show filename, clear on navigate away, no upload/save). This is a small but real gap — either add FileInput to ui.tsx or implement inline. Not overengineering, just missing primitive.
findings.evidence: ui.tsx exports listed above — no FileInput. Spec line 35: 'обязательный выбор файла... показать его имя до ухода со страницы, не передавать файл и не сохранять ни файл, ни его имя'.
findings.violated_requirement: Feasibility — missing UI primitive for specified interaction
findings.conditions: Implementing application form with file selection
findings.impact: Must create FileInput component or inline implementation; minor scope addition

summary: Spec is largely feasible and proportional for a frontend-only internal demo, extending existing mock.ts localStorage pattern and reusing RequireAuth, AuthContext, ui.tsx, and AdminOffersPage patterns. Five major findings block clean approval: (1) Currency mismatch (BYN vs ₽) requires new formatter or parameterized format.ts; (2) mock.ts save() silently swallows localStorage errors but spec requires error display and UI rollback — mock.ts must be updated to propagate write failures; (3) Microloan domain types and Api methods are missing from types.ts — significant type surface addition needed; (4) Admin type management rollback on persistence failure not supported by current mutate-then-save pattern; (5) Routing and navigation integration for 5 new routes not addressed in spec. Five minor findings: overengineering risk reusing mortgage PaymentChart/ScheduleTable for single-payment microloan; double-submit protection pattern doesn't exist; admin demo credential (email with 'admin') undocumented; mock auth credentials (any email/password) undocumented; FileInput component missing from ui.tsx. All findings are locally correctable without architectural changes.
